text.content:
A Thought That Is Not Yours

You hold your enemy’s gaze and whisper the outline of an impossible shape. They flinch as the image crowds into their thoughts.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One visible creature within 4 squares.

Let a fragment of an impossible thought pass between you.

- Weak: 2 mental damage. - Standard: 3 mental damage and Dazed 1. - Strong: 5 mental damage and Dazed 1.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Mind 1

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
